messages.text: The broad source pass exposed a platform boundary the snapshots do not cover, but the first oracle run was blocked before execution because its cleanup syntax triggered the command interceptor. I’m replacing that fragile inline probe with a bounded, read-only process-capture script and narrowing source inspection to the previously unseen Windows render modules. Exact implementation can begin once those outputs establish eza’s Windows size, timestamp, attribute, and grid rules.

commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .tura/script/probe_reference.ps1
+$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
+
+$binary = (Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..\REFERENCE_BINARY.txt")).Trim()
+$workspace = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..")).Path
+
+$cases = @(
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "-a", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "--sort=size", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "--sort=extension", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "--sort=Name", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "--group-directories-first", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-l", "--no-user", "--time-style=long-iso", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-T", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-T", "-L", "1", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-R", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-w", "25", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", ".tura/probe/alpha.txt", ".tura/probe/Beta.TXT"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", ".tura/probe/missing"),
+    @("--version"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "--bad-option"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "--sort", "bogus", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "--width", "bogus", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-la", ".tura/probe/alpha.txt"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-d", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-D", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-f", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "-r", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "--sort=modified", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", "--bytes", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", "--binary", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", "--no-permissions", "--header", ".tura/probe"),
+    @("--color=never", "--icons=never", "-T", "-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", ".tura/probe")
+)
+
+$number = 0
+foreach ($arguments in $cases) {
+    $number++
+    $info = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
+    $info.FileName = $binary
+    $info.WorkingDirectory = $workspace
+    $info.UseShellExecute = $false
+    $info.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $info.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    foreach ($argument in $arguments) {
+        [void]$info.ArgumentList.Add($argument)
+    }
+    $process = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($info)
+    $stdout = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()
+    $stderr = $process.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
+    $process.WaitForExit()
+    $stdoutJson = ConvertTo-Json $stdout -Compress
+    $stderrJson = ConvertTo-Json $stderr -Compress
+    Write-Output "CASE $number STATUS=$($process.ExitCode) ARGS=$($arguments -join ' ')"
+    Write-Output "STDOUT=$stdoutJson"
+    Write-Output "STDERR=$stderrJson"
+}
*** End Patch
